sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: part:370010 – proposal for the 2027 price basis and AS-14404 adjustment clause
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation and for taking the time to review our requirements. We would very much like to continue working with Werdenfels and appreciate your team's consideration of a longer-term arrangement.

Would you kindly consider EUR 4.60/kg for part:370010, with payment within 14 days net and a 36-month contract? We propose AS-14404 on a 45% material share, with a 0% deadband and base month 2026-08. Our annual requirement is 23,700 kg, with DAP delivery, a 14-day lead time, effective from 2027-01-01 and no tooling charges.

For context, our purchase orders with you for part:370010 on 2 and 17 June 2026 were at EUR 5.26/kg (po:4500014022-10, po:4500014078-10), compared with EUR 5.84/kg on 1 and 18 September 2026 (po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10).

We recognize the cost pressures you described. We hope that prompt payment, a longer commitment and the proposed adjustment mechanism provide a useful basis for reviewing the starting price together. If a 24-month commitment would suit your team better, we would be pleased to discuss that as well.

Thank you again for considering the package. Could you kindly let us know what binding offer you can approve?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have reviewed your proposal and acknowledge the historical purchase orders you referenced. 

We are pleased to accept your proposed 14-day payment terms, the 36-month contract, and the AS-14404 index clause. Based on this package, we can offer a revised price of EUR 5.40 per kg. 

To outline our adjusted Angebot fully: we present a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Please note that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: part:370010 – revised proposal at EUR 4.72/kg, 36 months with AS-14404 clause
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you very much for your quick and constructive reply, and for accepting the 14-day payment terms, the 36-month contract and the AS-14404 clause. We also appreciate that you checked our order records and took them into account.

The AS-14404 clause adjusts the material share for future index movements. For context, AS-14404 changed by -5.49% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09). We recognise that the annual change you described remains relevant.

With that in mind, would you kindly consider EUR 4.72/kg for part:370010? All other terms would stay as you confirmed: payment within 14 days net, a 36-month contract and AS-14404 on a 45% material share, with a 0% deadband and base month 2026-08.

Thank you again for your team's effort. We look forward to your view.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
